cases.test: Seek independent upstream queue and discriminate from local contention.

cases.hidden_to_solver: A published eligibility rule in another document, or no extra rule at all.
cases.test: Examine organizer goal and actual selection without inventing a secret cutoff.

cases.initial: Usage rises rapidly while subscription additions fall.

cases.test: Investigate downstream pricing, demand, costs and access to cohort data rather than declaring a single hidden market belief.
